title: Setup Rhino Plugin Debug Configuration
description: Add VSCode debug configuration (tasks.json build task + launch.json dev config) for the semio/3dm Rhino plugin. The setup should use the coreclr debugger, launch Rhino.exe with RHINO_PACKAGE_DIRS pointing to the build output, and use a preLaunchTask to build first. Also add a dev script to the package.json.
summary: Created Properties/launchSettings.json for Semio.Rhino with two VS debug profiles.
